messages:
maria (PM): Heads-up — customer Atlas asked for a predictable burst experience for their Dedicated pool during onboarding. They want a short-term surge (5m) up to ~10k tokens/s on top of a 2k baseline. cc @sophia :eyes:
aj (eng): Quick q — do they expect hard guarantees or a credits-style soft burst? pricing implication is big either way.
leo (eng-runtime): Technically we can do soft-reserve with token credits + preemption fallback. Hard reserve means dedicating GPUs which costs more.
sophia (sales): They expect 'guaranteed' in the commercial term but are open to tiers if we offer discounts. I'll push them but need clear launch criteria.
nate (sre): Operational flags: spillover protection, eviction noise, observability (per-tenant latency/cost) must be in place before any SLA claim. Need alert for p99 latency spike >500ms.
maria (PM): Proposed launch criteria (MVP):
- Canary with 3 customers for 2 weeks
- Billing export for burst usage + credits reconciliation
- Runbook: rollback to shared-hosted + incident playbook
- Automation test that simulates 2x expected burst for 10 mins
aj (eng): Implementation checklist (high level):
- API to set burst profile + credits ledger
- Autoscale gating to allow short bursts without full long-term scale-up
- Preemption policy config + tenant priority levels
- Billing pipeline hook for burst metering
leo (eng-runtime): Runtime notes: continuous batching warms up slowly — to hit 10k tokens/s for short windows we need warm kernels or a burst-warmup path. Recommend pre-warm on scheduled canary or maintain small hot slab.
aj (eng): API sketch for burst profile:
```json
POST /v1/dedicated/pools/{pool_id}/burst
{ "mode": "soft", "credits": 5000, "window_seconds": 300, "preempt_priority": 20 }
```
(we can refine fields later)
sophia (sales): Contract ask: they'd like a 'burst guarantee' clause. I'll draft language: "burst guarantee subject to capacity availability; remedies limited to credits/refund" — legal review needed.
maria (PM): Tradeoffs we need to call out in roadmap: stronger guarantees => reserved capacity model => higher price and longer procurement. Suggest 3-tier product: Bronze=best-effort, Silver=soft-reserve credits, Gold=hard-reserve SLA.
nate (sre): Suggested SLO targets for Silver pilot: baseline p95 <200ms, p99 <500ms during burst, error rate <0.5%. Add stress tests for eviction churn.
leo (eng-runtime): Risk: if many tenants use burst simultaneously, headroom is exhausted and preemption kicks in. Need fair-share algorithm + sticky routing to avoid oscillation.
maria (PM): Timeline proposal: kickoff tomorrow with eng-runtime + billing; MVP in 6 sprints if we accept scope (soft-reserve + credits + canary). Hard-reserve SLA would be a separate initiative. Who volunteers for owners?
sophia (sales): I'll own customer comms and contract draft.
leo (eng-runtime): I'll take runtime changes and canary orchestration.
aj (eng): I'll handle API + billing hooks.
nate (sre): I'll own alerts/runbook and the acceptance stress tests.
maria (PM): Action items: create JIRA epics, schedule a 30m kickoff, draft acceptance test matrix, add roadmap slide. :white_check_mark:
oncall-bot: Canary job scheduled at 1749157600 for pool-id:pool-atlas-canary — results will post to #product-canaries.
sophia (sales): thanks — I'll loop in legal and the customer tomorrow.
maria (PM): Great progress. Posting this thread to capture commitments.
